parsed.seniority_signal: Fachliche Begleitung und Mentoring innerhalb des Teams
parsed.notes:
IHR PROFIL is the requirements section; no section heading marks skills optional. Skills appearing only in the introductory responsibilities and IHRE AUFGABEN are excluded.
The productive-project preference does not soften the explicit requirement for experience in Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
OpenCV collapses into computer-vision under the supplied taxonomy; Generative AI and LLMs likewise collapse into llms.
The guide does not explicitly resolve slash notation: PyTorch/TensorFlow is interpreted as alternatives, whereas CUDA/TensorRT is interpreted as a combined technology stack, not interchangeable alternatives. Lists joined by und are not grouped.
Model Optimization is retained as unmapped rather than narrowed to inference optimization. On-premise/hybrid infrastructure does not independently name the broad cloud skill.
Scientific research is read literally as an optional technical practice; publications, patents and open-source contributions are evidence of that practice, not separate skills.
The highest degree named is the optional doctorate, although completed university studies are required. A comparable field is not an experience substitute.
Seniority rests on the mentoring duty, not on the nonspecific Mehrjährige Erfahrung or the first experience in technical supervision.
